主要内容: On September 17, 2013, Scott Mercer was appointed to the Board of Directors and the Audit Committee of SANDISK CORP. An indemnification agreement was entered into with Mr. Mercer, identical to the form previously filed with the SEC as Exhibit 10.1 to the Company’s Registration Statement on Form S-1 (File No. 33-96298). On September 11, 2013, the Board approved an amendment to the Bylaws, effective upon approval, increasing the Board size from eight to nine directors and designating the Court of Chancery of the State of Delaware as the sole and exclusive forum for derivative actions, fiduciary duty claims, and actions under Delaware General Corporation Law.
